story.text: 승객 여러분, 안녕하세요. 하늘 기장입니다. 지금부터 전주 한옥마을 상공으로 안내해 드리겠습니다.
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, an-nyeong-ha-se-yo. ha-neul gi-jang-im-ni-da. ji-geum-bu-teo jeon-ju han-ok-ma-eul sang-gong-eu-ro an-nae-hae deu-ri-get-seum-ni-da.
story.en: Hello, passengers. This is Captain Haneul. I'll now guide you over Jeonju Hanok Village.

story.text: 저 아래 기와지붕이 옹기종기 모인 곳, '한옥마을'이 보이시나요? 약 700여 채의 한옥이 모여 있어요.
story.reading: jeo a-rae gi-wa-ji-bung-i ong-gi-jong-gi mo-in got, han-ok-ma-eul-i bo-i-si-na-yo? yak chil-baek-yeo chae-ui han-ok-i mo-yeo it-seo-yo.
story.en: Do you see that place below where tiled roofs gather closely together? That's 'Hanok Village' — about 700 traditional houses are gathered there.

story.text: '한옥'은 나무와 흙, 돌로 짓는 우리나라 전통 집이에요. 자연의 재료로만 지어서 사람에게 참 편안하답니다.
story.reading: han-ok-eun na-mu-wa heuk, dol-lo jit-neun u-ri-na-ra jeon-tong jib-i-e-yo. ja-yeon-ui jae-ryo-ro-man ji-eo-seo sa-ram-e-ge cham pyeon-an-ha-dam-ni-da.
story.en: 'Hanok' is our country's traditional house, built with wood, clay, and stone. Made only from natural materials, it feels truly comfortable to people.

story.text: 한옥의 바닥 아래에는 '온돌'이 있어요. 아궁이에 불을 때면 바닥 전체가 따뜻해지는 지혜로운 난방법이지요.
story.reading: han-ok-ui ba-dak a-rae-e-neun on-dol-i it-seo-yo. a-gung-i-e bul-eul ttae-myeon ba-dak jeon-che-ga tta-tteut-hae-ji-neun ji-hye-ro-un nan-bang-beob-i-ji-yo.
story.en: Beneath a hanok's floor lies 'ondol'. When you light a fire in the furnace, the whole floor warms up — a wise heating method.

story.text: 지붕을 덮은 검은 기와도 눈여겨보세요. '기와'는 흙을 구워 만드는데, 비와 눈을 막아주는 튼튼한 지붕 재료예요.
story.reading: ji-bung-eul deop-eun geom-eun gi-wa-do nun-yeo-gyeo-bo-se-yo. gi-wa-neun heulg-eul gu-wo man-deu-neun-de, bi-wa nun-eul mag-a-ju-neun teun-teun-han ji-bung jae-ryo-ye-yo.
story.en: Take a closer look at the black roof tiles too. 'Giwa' (roof tile) is made by firing clay, and it's a sturdy roofing material that blocks rain and snow.

story.text: 한옥 가운데에는 시원한 나무 바닥, '마루'가 있어요. 여름에는 마루에 앉아 바람을 쐬며 쉬었답니다.
story.reading: han-ok ga-un-de-e-neun si-won-han na-mu ba-dak, ma-ru-ga it-seo-yo. yeo-reum-e-neun ma-ru-e anj-a ba-ram-eul ssoe-myeo swi-eot-dam-ni-da.
story.en: In the middle of a hanok there's a cool wooden floor called 'maru'. In summer, people would sit on the maru and rest in the breeze.

story.text: 자, 오늘 배운 다섯 단어로 전주 한옥마을을 함께 걸어볼까요? 문제를 풀며 확인해 보아요!
story.reading: ja, o-neul bae-un da-seot dan-eo-ro jeon-ju han-ok-ma-eul-eul ham-kke geol-eo-bol-kka-yo? mun-je-reul pul-myeo hwag-in-hae bo-a-yo!
story.en: Now, shall we walk through Jeonju Hanok Village together using the five words we learned today? Let's check by solving some questions!

words.example_en: Hanok is a house built with wood and clay.
There are many tile-roofed houses in Hanok Village.
Roof tiles are the material that covers the roof.
I sit and rest on the wooden floor.

sentences.en: Hanok houses are common in Jeonju.
Thanks to ondol, it's warm even in winter.
We welcome guests on the wooden floor.
